yavsos_grid_kept_out: Item icon tooltip in the Items tab, for an amber icon: AzuAutoStore's settings keep the item out of this chest type.
yavsos_grid_mark_accepted: Item icon tooltip in the Items tab, for an icon without a mark. Not a fixed spot.
yavsos_grid_mark_always: Item icon tooltip in the Items tab, under the game's own item tooltip. Not a fixed spot. {{always}}: the mark's name (yavsos_grid_always). The item is marked Always and the ticked categories accept it too.
yavsos_grid_mark_always_only: Item icon tooltip in the Items tab. Not a fixed spot. {{always}}: the mark's name (yavsos_grid_always). Marked Always; no ticked category accepts it.
yavsos_grid_mark_click: Item icon tooltip in the Items tab, the line under the mark's sentence: what a click does. {{always}}, {{never}}: the marks' names; 'clear': no mark.
yavsos_grid_mark_never: Item icon tooltip in the Items tab. Not a fixed spot. {{never}}: the mark's name (yavsos_grid_never).
yavsos_grid_mark_not_accepted: Item icon tooltip in the Items tab, for an icon without a mark. Not a fixed spot.
yavsos_grid_marked: Title of a group in the Items tab's grid, one line at 15 px (about 50 characters). {{count}}: icons in the group. {{always}}, {{never}}: the item marks' names (yavsos_grid_always, yavsos_grid_never). Items marked Always or Never that the ticked categories don't accept.
yavsos_grid_missing: Item icon tooltip in the Items tab, for an item a rule names that this game no longer has (its mod was removed).
yavsos_grid_never: The item mark 'Never' (the item is never accepted here), as the panel and the player guide call it. Other messages quote it, so they use this key; capitalized, as on the panel.
yavsos_grid_rule: Title of a group in the Items tab's grid, one line at 15 px (about 50 characters). {{count}}: icons in the group. Items the rule's categories and filters accept.
yavsos_highlight_accepts: A line added under a lit chest's hover text (point at the chest), in the chest's light color. Not a fixed spot, but keep it short: one line under the game's hover text. The chest's rule accepts something the search asks for. {{items}}: the category's name, or up to two names of the searched items this chest accepts, joined with yavsos_list_comma_* and '+N more'.
yavsos_highlight_accepts_it: A line added under a lit chest's hover text (point at the chest), in the chest's light color. Not a fixed spot, but keep it short: one line under the game's hover text. As yavsos_highlight_accepts when the search names nothing.
yavsos_highlight_amount: An item and how many of it a lit chest holds, in yavsos_highlight_holds. {{item}}: the item's name, in the player's language; {{amount}}: how many, in digits.
yavsos_highlight_holds: A line added under a lit chest's hover text (point at the chest), in the chest's light color. Not a fixed spot, but keep it short: one line under the game's hover text. The chest holds something the search asks for. {{items}}: yavsos_highlight_amount for the first such item, then '+N more' (yavsos_list_more) for other matching items.
yavsos_highlight_stays: A line added under a lit chest's hover text (point at the chest), in the chest's light color. Not a fixed spot, but keep it short: one line under the game's hover text. After cleanup: items stay in this chest because no chest accepts them. {{items}}: the first item's name, then '+N more' for other items; {{count}}: how many items in all (picks the one-item or several-items form; the several-items form puts the list last); not shown.
yavsos_highlight_stays_full: A line added under a lit chest's hover text (point at the chest), in the chest's light color. Not a fixed spot, but keep it short: one line under the game's hover text. After cleanup: items stay in this chest because the chests that accept them are full. {{items}}: the first item's name, then '+N more'; {{count}}: how many items in all; not shown.
yavsos_hud_message: Every YAVSOS on-screen message, top left or center. {{text}}: the message itself, already translated. YAVSOS is the mod's name.
yavsos_key_alt: Key name, in key hints such as 'Alt + .'.
yavsos_key_ctrl: Key name, in key hints such as 'Ctrl + .'.
yavsos_key_enter: Key name of the Return/Enter key, in key hints.
yavsos_key_esc: Key name of the Escape key, in key hints.
yavsos_key_join_end: Keys pressed together, last two: 'Shift + .'. {{first}}: a key; {{rest}}: the last key.
yavsos_key_join_middle: Keys pressed together, between the first and the last two. {{first}}: a key; {{rest}}: the rest, already joined.
yavsos_key_join_pair: Two keys pressed together: 'Ctrl + .'. {{first}}: the modifier; {{rest}}: the key.
yavsos_key_join_start: Three or more keys pressed together, the first: 'Ctrl + …'. {{first}}: the first key; {{rest}}: the rest, already joined.
yavsos_key_mouse: Name of an extra mouse button, in key hints. {{number}}: the button's number, 4 and up.
yavsos_key_mouse_left: Key name of the left mouse button, in key hints such as 'Stash stack [Left mouse]'.
yavsos_key_mouse_middle: Key name of the middle mouse button (YAVSOS's default stack key), in key hints such as 'Stash stack [Middle mouse]'.
yavsos_key_mouse_right: Key name of the right mouse button, in key hints.
yavsos_key_numpad: Name of a number-pad key, in key hints. {{key}}: the key on the pad, such as 5 or Plus.
yavsos_key_shift: Key name, in key hints such as 'Shift + .'.
yavsos_label_anything: Chest label: added to a chest's hover text in gold, at most 56 characters in all (cut with '…'); the folded YAVSOS panel's line and the Rule heading's tooltip show it too. The guide quotes 'Food › eaten by Boar · priority 2 (Urgent)'. The label of a rule that accepts every item.
yavsos_label_base_game: A phrase in the chest label (56 characters in all), the filters chip ('only …', 40 characters) and the filters chip's tooltip heading. Lower case: it continues the label after ' › ' or 'only'. A filter that accepts the game itself as an item's origin, inside 'from {{values}}'.
yavsos_label_condition_unknown: A phrase in the chest label (56 characters in all), the filters chip ('only …', 40 characters) and the filters chip's tooltip heading. Lower case: it continues the label after ' › ' or 'only'. A filter that accepts stacks whose durability isn't known.
yavsos_label_crafted_by: A phrase in the chest label (56 characters in all), the filters chip ('only …', 40 characters) and the filters chip's tooltip heading. Lower case: it continues the label after ' › ' or 'only'. Stacks by who crafted them: 'crafted by me'. {{values}}: player names or yavsos_filter_value_crafter_*, joined with yavsos_list_or_*.
yavsos_label_damaged: A phrase in the chest label (56 characters in all), the filters chip ('only …', 40 characters) and the filters chip's tooltip heading. Lower case: it continues the label after ' › ' or 'only'. A filter that accepts stacks worn below full durability.
yavsos_label_eaten_by: A phrase in the chest label (56 characters in all), the filters chip ('only …', 40 characters) and the filters chip's tooltip heading. Lower case: it continues the label after ' › ' or 'only'. Items tamed creatures eat: 'eaten by Boar or Lox'. {{values}}: the creatures' names from the game, joined with yavsos_list_or_*. Also a fact in the item tooltip's category line (80 characters), where the names are joined with yavsos_list_comma_*: 'eaten by Boar, Hen'.
yavsos_label_filtered: Chest label: added to a chest's hover text in gold, at most 56 characters in all (cut with '…'); the folded YAVSOS panel's line and the Rule heading's tooltip show it too. The guide quotes 'Food › eaten by Boar · priority 2 (Urgent)'. {{names}}: category names (or the Always items), joined with yavsos_list_comma_*, maybe with '+N'; {{filters}}: the filters in short words. English and the guide use ' › ' between them.
yavsos_label_filters_more: Chest label: added to a chest's hover text in gold, at most 56 characters in all (cut with '…'); the folded YAVSOS panel's line and the Rule heading's tooltip show it too. The guide quotes 'Food › eaten by Boar · priority 2 (Urgent)'. The first set of filters, then how many more filtered parts the rule has. {{filters}}: the filters in short words; {{count}}: how many more. Keep it short.
yavsos_label_food: A phrase in the chest label (56 characters in all), the filters chip ('only …', 40 characters) and the filters chip's tooltip heading. Lower case: it continues the label after ' › ' or 'only'. Foods by their main stat: 'stamina or eitr food'. {{values}}: the stats (yavsos_filter_value_food_*), joined with yavsos_list_or_*.
yavsos_label_from: A phrase in the chest label (56 characters in all), the filters chip ('only …', 40 characters) and the filters chip's tooltip heading. Lower case: it continues the label after ' › ' or 'only'. Items by the mod that adds them: 'from Therzie.Warfare', 'from the base game'. {{values}}: mod names as the mods give them, or yavsos_label_base_game, joined with yavsos_list_or_*.
yavsos_label_level_unknown: A phrase in the chest label (56 characters in all), the filters chip ('only …', 40 characters) and the filters chip's tooltip heading. Lower case: it continues the label after ' › ' or 'only'. A filter that accepts stacks whose upgrade level isn't known.
yavsos_label_more: Chest label: added to a chest's hover text in gold, at most 56 characters in all (cut with '…'); the folded YAVSOS panel's line and the Rule heading's tooltip show it too. The guide quotes 'Food › eaten by Boar · priority 2 (Urgent)'. The names that fit, then how many didn't: 'Stamina foods, Food ingredients +3'. Also in the item tooltip's category line (80 characters). {{names}}: names joined with yavsos_list_comma_*; {{count}}: how many more. Keep it short.
yavsos_label_no_food_stat: A phrase in the chest label (56 characters in all), the filters chip ('only …', 40 characters) and the filters chip's tooltip heading. Lower case: it continues the label after ' › ' or 'only'. A filter that accepts items without a food stat.
yavsos_label_no_tame: A phrase in the chest label (56 characters in all), the filters chip ('only …', 40 characters) and the filters chip's tooltip heading. Lower case: it continues the label after ' › ' or 'only'. A filter that accepts items no tamed creature eats.
yavsos_label_not_crafted: A phrase in the chest label (56 characters in all), the filters chip ('only …', 40 characters) and the filters chip's tooltip heading. Lower case: it continues the label after ' › ' or 'only'. A filter that accepts items nobody crafted.
yavsos_label_not_teleportable: A phrase in the chest label (56 characters in all), the filters chip ('only …', 40 characters) and the filters chip's tooltip heading. Lower case: it continues the label after ' › ' or 'only'. A filter that accepts items the game keeps out of portals. Also a fact in the item tooltip's category line (80 characters), after its categories.
yavsos_label_not_upgradable: A phrase in the chest label (56 characters in all), the filters chip ('only …', 40 characters) and the filters chip's tooltip heading. Lower case: it continues the label after ' › ' or 'only'. A filter that accepts items no recipe can upgrade.
yavsos_label_not_upgraded: A phrase in the chest label (56 characters in all), the filters chip ('only …', 40 characters) and the filters chip's tooltip heading. Lower case: it continues the label after ' › ' or 'only'. A filter that accepts an old rule's upgraded filter, no.
yavsos_label_nothing: Chest label: added to a chest's hover text in gold, at most 56 characters in all (cut with '…'); the folded YAVSOS panel's line and the Rule heading's tooltip show it too. The guide quotes 'Food › eaten by Boar · priority 2 (Urgent)'. The label of a rule that accepts no item.
yavsos_label_portals_unknown: A phrase in the chest label (56 characters in all), the filters chip ('only …', 40 characters) and the filters chip's tooltip heading. Lower case: it continues the label after ' › ' or 'only'. A filter that accepts items YAVSOS can't tell go through portals or not.
yavsos_label_rarity_better: A phrase in the chest label (56 characters in all), the filters chip ('only …', 40 characters) and the filters chip's tooltip heading. Lower case: it continues the label after ' › ' or 'only'. A rarity and every one above it: 'rare or better'. {{rarity}}: the lowest of them (yavsos_filter_value_rarity_*).
yavsos_label_teleportable: A phrase in the chest label (56 characters in all), the filters chip ('only …', 40 characters) and the filters chip's tooltip heading. Lower case: it continues the label after ' › ' or 'only'. A filter that accepts items the game lets through portals.
yavsos_label_undamaged: A phrase in the chest label (56 characters in all), the filters chip ('only …', 40 characters) and the filters chip's tooltip heading. Lower case: it continues the label after ' › ' or 'only'. A filter that accepts stacks at full durability.
yavsos_label_unknown: A phrase in the chest label (56 characters in all), the filters chip ('only …', 40 characters) and the filters chip's tooltip heading. Lower case: it continues the label after ' › ' or 'only'. A filter this YAVSOS version doesn't name, for items without its answer. {{filter}}: the filter's ID as stored, such as 'related-mod'.
yavsos_label_unused: A phrase in the chest label (56 characters in all), the filters chip ('only …', 40 characters) and the filters chip's tooltip heading. Lower case: it continues the label after ' › ' or 'only'. A filter that accepts items with no known use.
yavsos_label_upgradable: A phrase in the chest label (56 characters in all), the filters chip ('only …', 40 characters) and the filters chip's tooltip heading. Lower case: it continues the label after ' › ' or 'only'. A filter that accepts items a recipe can upgrade.
yavsos_label_upgradable_unknown: A phrase in the chest label (56 characters in all), the filters chip ('only …', 40 characters) and the filters chip's tooltip heading. Lower case: it continues the label after ' › ' or 'only'. A filter that accepts items YAVSOS can't tell can be upgraded or not.
yavsos_label_upgrade_level: A phrase in the chest label (56 characters in all), the filters chip ('only …', 40 characters) and the filters chip's tooltip heading. Lower case: it continues the label after ' › ' or 'only'. Stacks by upgrade level: 'upgrade level 2 or 3'. {{values}}: the levels (1 to 4, or '5+'), joined with yavsos_list_or_*.
yavsos_label_upgraded: A phrase in the chest label (56 characters in all), the filters chip ('only …', 40 characters) and the filters chip's tooltip heading. Lower case: it continues the label after ' › ' or 'only'. A filter that accepts an old rule's upgraded filter, yes.
yavsos_label_upgraded_unknown: A phrase in the chest label (56 characters in all), the filters chip ('only …', 40 characters) and the filters chip's tooltip heading. Lower case: it continues the label after ' › ' or 'only'. A filter that accepts an old rule's upgraded filter, for items whose upgrade isn't known.
yavsos_label_used_for: A phrase in the chest label (56 characters in all), the filters chip ('only …', 40 characters) and the filters chip's tooltip heading. Lower case: it continues the label after ' › ' or 'only'. Items by use: 'used for fuel'. {{values}}: the uses (yavsos_filter_value_usage_*), joined with yavsos_list_or_*.
yavsos_list_and_end: List of names, last two: 'Tin and Iron'. {{first}}: the next-to-last name; {{rest}}: the last. A list of two uses yavsos_list_and_pair.
yavsos_list_and_middle: List of names, between the first and the last two: 'Tin, …'. {{first}}: a name; {{rest}}: the rest of the list, already joined.
yavsos_list_and_pair: List of exactly two names: 'Copper and Tin'. {{first}}, {{rest}}: the two names.
yavsos_list_and_start: List of three or more names, the first: 'Copper, …'. {{first}}: the first name; {{rest}}: the rest of the list, already joined.
yavsos_list_comma_end: List of names without 'and' or 'or', last two: 'Tin, Iron'. {{first}}: the next-to-last name; {{rest}}: the last.
yavsos_list_comma_middle: List of names without 'and' or 'or', between the first and the last two. {{first}}: a name; {{rest}}: the rest, already joined.
yavsos_list_comma_pair: List of exactly two names without 'and' or 'or': 'Copper, Tin'. {{first}}, {{rest}}: the two names. Also joins the values and the filters of a filter phrase in the chest label (yavsos_label_*).
yavsos_list_comma_start: List of three or more names without 'and' or 'or', the first. {{first}}: the first name; {{rest}}: the rest, already joined.
yavsos_list_lines_more: A list of names, one per line, that was cut: the last line says how many more there are. {{list}}: the lines shown; {{count}}: how many were left out.
yavsos_list_more: A list of names that was cut: 'Copper, Tin +3 more'. {{list}}: the names shown, already joined; {{count}}: how many were left out.
yavsos_list_or_end: List of choices, last two: 'Tin or Iron'. {{first}}: the next-to-last name; {{rest}}: the last. A list of two uses yavsos_list_or_pair.
yavsos_list_or_middle: List of choices, between the first and the last two. {{first}}: a name; {{rest}}: the rest, already joined.
yavsos_list_or_pair: List of exactly two choices: 'Copper or Tin'. {{first}}, {{rest}}: the two choices. Also joins the values and the filters of a filter phrase in the chest label (yavsos_label_*).
yavsos_list_or_start: List of three or more choices, the first: 'Copper, …'. {{first}}: the first name; {{rest}}: the rest, already joined.
yavsos_list_parts_end: Joins the last two parts of one line that holds several phrases, such as a run summary ('Moved 4 stacks (63 items) · 2 stay in place (no room)'). {{first}}, {{rest}}: the parts. English uses a middle dot with a space on each side. Also between the parts of the chest label ('Food › eaten by Boar · priority 2 (Urgent)', 56 characters, quoted in the guide) and of the item tooltip's category line ('Animal feed · eaten by Boar · not teleportable', 80 characters).
yavsos_list_parts_middle: Joins a middle part to the rest of a line of several phrases (see yavsos_list_parts_end). {{first}}, {{rest}}: the parts.
yavsos_list_parts_pair: Joins the two parts of a line of two phrases (see yavsos_list_parts_end). {{first}}, {{rest}}: the parts.
yavsos_list_parts_start: Joins the first part to the rest of a line of several phrases (see yavsos_list_parts_end). {{first}}, {{rest}}: the parts.
yavsos_mark_azu_exclusions: Status mark tooltip line (top right of the YAVSOS panel), after the state word (yavsos_mark_line). Not a fixed spot. A full sentence. AzuAutoStore mark. 'AzuAutoStore's exclusions': its settings that keep items out of chest types.
yavsos_mark_azu_exclusions_changed: Status mark tooltip line (top right of the YAVSOS panel), after the state word (yavsos_mark_line). Not a fixed spot. A full sentence. AzuAutoStore mark. 'Exclusions': AzuAutoStore's settings that keep items out of chest types.
yavsos_mark_azu_exclusions_errors: Status mark tooltip line (top right of the YAVSOS panel), after the state word (yavsos_mark_line). Not a fixed spot. A full sentence. AzuAutoStore mark. {{count}}: how many reads failed this session, in digits. YAVSOS tries again on each check.
yavsos_mark_azu_exclusions_unreadable: Status mark tooltip line (top right of the YAVSOS panel), after the state word (yavsos_mark_line). Not a fixed spot. A full sentence. AzuAutoStore mark. 'AzuAutoStore's exclusions': its settings that keep items out of chest types.
yavsos_mark_azu_kept_out: Status mark tooltip line (top right of the YAVSOS panel), after the state word (yavsos_mark_line). Not a fixed spot. A full sentence. AzuAutoStore mark, after the state word 'This chest'. {{count}}: how many of the rule's items; {{items}}: up to five item names, joined with yavsos_list_comma_* and '+N more' (yavsos_list_more); {{tab}}: the Items tab's name (yavsos_tab_items). 'Amber': the color of those item icons on that tab.
yavsos_mark_azu_kept_out_item: Status mark tooltip line (top right of the YAVSOS panel), after the state word (yavsos_mark_line). Not a fixed spot. A full sentence. AzuAutoStore mark, after the state word 'This chest'. {{item}}: the item's name, in the player's language; {{tab}}: the Items tab's name (yavsos_tab_items). 'Amber': the color of that item's icon on that tab.
yavsos_mark_azu_name: Status mark tooltip heading (top right of the YAVSOS panel). Not a fixed spot. The mod's name when its version is unknown; keep it as written.
yavsos_mark_azu_name_version: Status mark tooltip heading (top right of the YAVSOS panel). Not a fixed spot. {{version}}: AzuAutoStore's version, such as 3.1.7. Keep the mod's name as written.
yavsos_mark_azu_order: Status mark tooltip line (top right of the YAVSOS panel), after the state word (yavsos_mark_line). Not a fixed spot. A full sentence. AzuAutoStore mark. 'Priority': the chest priority set in the YAVSOS panel.
yavsos_mark_azu_order_broken: Status mark tooltip line (top right of the YAVSOS panel), after the state word (yavsos_mark_line). Not a fixed spot. A full sentence. AzuAutoStore mark. Also a faint note in the item tooltip, under or in place of the where-line (yavsos_where_line).
yavsos_mark_azu_pause: Status mark tooltip line (top right of the YAVSOS panel), after the state word (yavsos_mark_line). Not a fixed spot. A full sentence. AzuAutoStore mark.
yavsos_mark_azu_pause_unreadable: Status mark tooltip line (top right of the YAVSOS panel), after the state word (yavsos_mark_line). Not a fixed spot. A full sentence. AzuAutoStore mark.
yavsos_mark_azu_pickup: Status mark tooltip line (top right of the YAVSOS panel), after the state word (yavsos_mark_line). Not a fixed spot. A full sentence. AzuAutoStore mark. 'Ground pickup': AzuAutoStore putting items the player picks up into nearby chests.
yavsos_mark_azu_pickup_broken: Status mark tooltip line (top right of the YAVSOS panel), after the state word (yavsos_mark_line). Not a fixed spot. A full sentence. AzuAutoStore mark.
yavsos_mark_azu_rules: Status mark tooltip line (top right of the YAVSOS panel), after the state word (yavsos_mark_line). Not a fixed spot. A full sentence. AzuAutoStore mark. 'Ground pickup': AzuAutoStore putting items the player picks up into nearby chests.
yavsos_mark_azu_rules_broken: Status mark tooltip line (top right of the YAVSOS panel), after the state word (yavsos_mark_line). Not a fixed spot. A full sentence. AzuAutoStore mark. 'AzuAutoStore's stash key': its key that stashes the whole inventory.
yavsos_mark_categories_from_game: Status mark tooltip line (top right of the YAVSOS panel), after the state word (yavsos_mark_line). Not a fixed spot. A full sentence. Categories mark. 'Category settings': the player's own categories file.
yavsos_mark_categories_from_server: Status mark tooltip line (top right of the YAVSOS panel), after the state word (yavsos_mark_line). Not a fixed spot. A full sentence. Categories mark. 'Category settings': the server's categories file.
yavsos_mark_categories_gave_up: Status mark tooltip line (top right of the YAVSOS panel), after the state word (yavsos_mark_line). Not a fixed spot. A full sentence. Categories mark. 'Always', 'Never': the item marks, as on the panel.
yavsos_mark_categories_loading: Status mark tooltip line (top right of the YAVSOS panel), after the state word (yavsos_mark_line). Not a fixed spot. A full sentence. Categories mark, for a few seconds after joining a world. 'Always', 'Never': the item marks, as on the panel.
yavsos_mark_categories_name: Status mark tooltip heading (top right of the YAVSOS panel). Not a fixed spot.
yavsos_mark_categories_ready: Status mark tooltip line (top right of the YAVSOS panel), after the state word (yavsos_mark_line). Not a fixed spot. A full sentence. Categories mark. {{count}}: how many items YAVSOS sorted, digits without grouping.
yavsos_mark_categories_server_rejected: Status mark tooltip line (top right of the YAVSOS panel), after the state word (yavsos_mark_line). Not a fixed spot. A full sentence. Categories mark. 'Always', 'Never': the item marks, as on the panel.
yavsos_mark_categories_stale: Status mark tooltip line (top right of the YAVSOS panel), after the state word (yavsos_mark_line). Not a fixed spot. A full sentence. Categories mark.
yavsos_mark_cleanup_azu_unreadable: Status mark tooltip line (top right of the YAVSOS panel), after the state word (yavsos_mark_line). Not a fixed spot. A full sentence. Cleanup mark. 'AzuAutoStore's exclusions': its settings that keep items out of chest types; 'the AzuAutoStore mark': the status mark of that name beside this one.
yavsos_mark_cleanup_chests_unreadable: Status mark tooltip line (top right of the YAVSOS panel), after the state word (yavsos_mark_line). Not a fixed spot. A full sentence. Cleanup mark.
yavsos_mark_cleanup_name: Status mark tooltip heading (top right of the YAVSOS panel). Not a fixed spot. Cleanup: moving misplaced items between nearby chests (the noun).
yavsos_mark_cleanup_off: Status mark tooltip line (top right of the YAVSOS panel), after the state word (yavsos_mark_line). Not a fixed spot. A full sentence. Cleanup mark. {{setting}}: the setting's name, Server.AllowCleanup; it isn't translated.
yavsos_mark_display_name: Status mark tooltip heading (top right of the YAVSOS panel). Not a fixed spot. Shown only when a display part turned itself off after an error.
yavsos_mark_display_off: Status mark tooltip line (top right of the YAVSOS panel), after the state word (yavsos_mark_line). Not a fixed spot. A full sentence. Display mark. {{parts}}: one to six part names (yavsos_mark_display_part_*), joined with yavsos_list_and_*; {{count}}: how many, which picks 'it' or 'them' (not shown).
yavsos_mark_display_part_categories: A part name inside yavsos_mark_display_off, read after 'YAVSOS turned off'. The line in item tooltips naming the item's category.
yavsos_mark_display_part_glow: A part name inside yavsos_mark_display_off, read after 'YAVSOS turned off'. The glow on chests that received items.
yavsos_mark_display_part_labels: A part name inside yavsos_mark_display_off, read after 'YAVSOS turned off'. 'Chest labels': the rule text YAVSOS adds to a chest's hover text.
yavsos_mark_display_part_results: A part name inside yavsos_mark_display_off, read after 'YAVSOS turned off'. 'Result panel': the panel listing what a stash or cleanup moved.
yavsos_mark_display_part_search: A part name inside yavsos_mark_display_off, read after 'YAVSOS turned off'.
yavsos_mark_display_part_where: A part name inside yavsos_mark_display_off, read after 'YAVSOS turned off'. The line in item tooltips that says which chest a stack would go to.
yavsos_mark_drawers_broken: Status mark tooltip line (top right of the YAVSOS panel), after the state word (yavsos_mark_line). Not a fixed spot. A full sentence. Item drawers mark. Keep the mod's name as written.
yavsos_mark_drawers_name: Status mark tooltip heading (top right of the YAVSOS panel). Not a fixed spot. Shown with the RossItemDrawers mod installed.
yavsos_mark_drawers_no_azu: Status mark tooltip line (top right of the YAVSOS panel), after the state word (yavsos_mark_line). Not a fixed spot. A full sentence. Item drawers mark.
yavsos_mark_drawers_reserved: Status mark tooltip line (top right of the YAVSOS panel), after the state word (yavsos_mark_line). Not a fixed spot. A full sentence. Item drawers mark. 'Reserved': a drawer set to hold one item, even while empty.
yavsos_mark_epicloot_broken: Status mark tooltip line (top right of the YAVSOS panel), after the state word (yavsos_mark_line). Not a fixed spot. A full sentence. EpicLoot mark. 'Rarity': the Filters tab's filter name; use the same word.
yavsos_mark_epicloot_name: Status mark tooltip heading (top right of the YAVSOS panel). Not a fixed spot. The mod's name; keep it as written.
yavsos_mark_epicloot_rarity: Status mark tooltip line (top right of the YAVSOS panel), after the state word (yavsos_mark_line). Not a fixed spot. A full sentence. EpicLoot mark. 'Rarity': the Filters tab's filter name; use the same word.
yavsos_mark_line: One line of a status mark's tooltip. {{state}}: the state word (yavsos_mark_state_*), drawn in the state's color; {{text}}: the line's sentence, already translated. Reorder or change the colon as your language needs.
yavsos_mark_muc_azu: Status mark tooltip line (top right of the YAVSOS panel), after the state word (yavsos_mark_line). Not a fixed spot. A full sentence. MultiUserChest mark: AzuAutoStore carries its own copy of MultiUserChest.
yavsos_mark_muc_name: Status mark tooltip heading (top right of the YAVSOS panel). Not a fixed spot. The mod's name; keep it as written.
yavsos_mark_muc_none: Status mark tooltip line (top right of the YAVSOS panel), after the state word (yavsos_mark_line). Not a fixed spot. A full sentence. MultiUserChest mark.
yavsos_mark_muc_standalone: Status mark tooltip line (top right of the YAVSOS panel), after the state word (yavsos_mark_line). Not a fixed spot. A full sentence. MultiUserChest mark, with the MultiUserChest mod installed. Keep the mod's name as written.
yavsos_mark_muc_yavsos: Status mark tooltip line (top right of the YAVSOS panel), after the state word (yavsos_mark_line). Not a fixed spot. A full sentence. MultiUserChest mark: YAVSOS carries its own copy of MultiUserChest.
yavsos_mark_server_name: Status mark tooltip heading (top right of the YAVSOS panel). Not a fixed spot. Shown only on a server without YAVSOS.
yavsos_mark_server_without_yavsos: Status mark tooltip line (top right of the YAVSOS panel), after the state word (yavsos_mark_line). Not a fixed spot. A full sentence. Server mark.
yavsos_mark_stashing_chests_unreadable: Status mark tooltip line (top right of the YAVSOS panel), after the state word (yavsos_mark_line). Not a fixed spot. A full sentence. Stashing mark.
yavsos_mark_stashing_name: Status mark tooltip heading (top right of the YAVSOS panel). Not a fixed spot. Shown when AzuAutoStore isn't installed, so YAVSOS stashes itself.
yavsos_mark_stashing_off: Status mark tooltip line (top right of the YAVSOS panel), after the state word (yavsos_mark_line). Not a fixed spot. A full sentence. Stashing mark. {{setting}}: the setting's name, Server.AllowStashing; it isn't translated.
yavsos_mark_stashing_on: Status mark tooltip line (top right of the YAVSOS panel), after the state word (yavsos_mark_line). Not a fixed spot. A full sentence. Stashing mark. {{stash}}: the stash key, such as '.'; {{stack}}: the stack key, such as 'Middle mouse'.
yavsos_mark_stashing_on_stack: Status mark tooltip line (top right of the YAVSOS panel), after the state word (yavsos_mark_line). Not a fixed spot. A full sentence. Stashing mark, when the stash key is unset. {{stack}}: the stack key, such as 'Middle mouse'.
yavsos_mark_stashing_on_stash: Status mark tooltip line (top right of the YAVSOS panel), after the state word (yavsos_mark_line). Not a fixed spot. A full sentence. Stashing mark, when the stack key is unset. {{stash}}: the stash key, such as '.'.
yavsos_mark_stashing_on_unbound: Status mark tooltip line (top right of the YAVSOS panel), after the state word (yavsos_mark_line). Not a fixed spot. A full sentence. Stashing mark, when both keys are unset.
yavsos_mark_state_broken: State word that starts a status mark's tooltip line (yavsos_mark_line), red: this part doesn't work.
yavsos_mark_state_caution: State word that starts a status mark's tooltip line (yavsos_mark_line), amber: the part works, with something to know about the open chest.
yavsos_mark_state_limited: State word that starts a status mark's tooltip line (yavsos_mark_line), amber: one optional part is off and the rest works.
yavsos_mark_state_off: State word that starts a status mark's tooltip line (yavsos_mark_line), gray: a setting turned this part off.
yavsos_mark_state_working: State word that starts a status mark's tooltip line (yavsos_mark_line), green: this part works.
yavsos_notice_chests_unreadable: On-screen message, center, once per session, when the game changed so YAVSOS can't read chests.
yavsos_notice_chests_unreadable_azu: As yavsos_notice_chests_unreadable, with AzuAutoStore installed (it stashes items without YAVSOS).
yavsos_notice_panel_off: On-screen message, center, once per session, when the YAVSOS panel failed to draw.
yavsos_panel_banner_in_use: Banner in the strip under the YAVSOS panel's header while another player has the chest open; 2 lines of about 52 characters.
yavsos_panel_banner_unreadable: Banner in the strip under the YAVSOS panel's header for a rule this YAVSOS version can't read, when YAVSOS does the stashing; the strip is 3 lines high in this case, about 52 characters each.
yavsos_panel_banner_unreadable_azu: Banner in the strip under the YAVSOS panel's header for a rule this YAVSOS version can't read, when AzuAutoStore does the stashing; the strip is 3 lines high in this case, about 52 characters each.
yavsos_panel_fold: Heading of the fold button's tooltip (the button is an arrow) while the panel is open.
yavsos_panel_fold_tip: Fold button's tooltip while the panel is open.
yavsos_panel_label_heading: Tooltip heading over the chest label, on the Rule heading, the chips and the strip under the YAVSOS panel's header.
yavsos_panel_label_line_tip: Tooltip of the strip under the YAVSOS panel's header on the folded panel, under the chest label when there is one. 'Unfold': the fold button (yavsos_panel_unfold).
yavsos_panel_label_strip_tip: Tooltip of the strip under the YAVSOS panel's header while it shows the chest label (unfolded panel), under the label itself.
yavsos_panel_label_tip: Tooltip of the Rule heading and the chips. {{label}}: the chest label, in the label color, on its own line.
yavsos_panel_label_tip_hidden: A line added to the chest label tooltip. {{setting}}: YAVSOS's setting name ShowChestLabels, as the settings list shows it.
yavsos_panel_label_tip_norule: Tooltip of the Rule heading and the chips for a chest without a rule.
yavsos_panel_norule: Faint, in the strip under the YAVSOS panel's header (also while folded) for a chest without a rule, when no message or banner shows; one line of about 50 characters.
yavsos_panel_title_heading: Tooltip heading of the panel's title 'YAVSOS'. {{version}}: YAVSOS's version, such as 1.2.0.
yavsos_panel_title_tip: Tooltip of the panel's title. {{name}}: what YAVSOS stands for, in English (Yet Another Valheim Storage Organization System), on its own line.
yavsos_panel_unfold: Heading of the fold button's tooltip while the panel is folded.
yavsos_panel_unfold_tip: Fold button's tooltip while the panel is folded.
yavsos_priority_critical: Priority name of level 1 (fills first). The player guide quotes it.
yavsos_priority_fuhgeddaboudit: Priority name of level 10 (fills last), a joke spelling of 'forget about it'. The player guide quotes it; a playful word in your language is fine. At most about 16 characters.
yavsos_priority_heading: Tooltip heading of a number on the priority bar (1 to 10). {{level}}: the number; {{name}}: its name.
yavsos_priority_heading_chosen: Tooltip heading of the number this chest has. {{level}}: the number; {{name}}: its name.
yavsos_priority_normal: Priority name of levels 4 and 5 (5 is the default). The player guide quotes it.
yavsos_priority_short: Priority inside the chest label, such as 'Food › eaten by Boar · priority 2 (Urgent)'; the guide quotes that example. {{level}}: the number; {{name}}: its name. Also the end of the chest label (56 characters in all), joined to it with yavsos_list_parts_*.
yavsos_priority_tip: Tooltip body of a number on the priority bar.
yavsos_priority_tip_norule: Tooltip body of a number on the priority bar, for a chest without a rule (the bar is faint and does nothing).
yavsos_priority_urgent: Priority name of levels 2 and 3. The player guide quotes it.
yavsos_reason_azu_excluded: A reason in brackets after a count of stacks that stay: '2 stay in place (…)', '1 stays in your inventory (…)'. Lower case: it continues a sentence. AzuAutoStore's settings keep this item out of the only chests that would accept it. Also in brackets in the item tooltip's where-line ('Stash stack: stays in your inventory (…)', 160 characters in all).
yavsos_reason_azu_excluded_types: A reason in brackets after a count of stacks that stay: '2 stay in place (…)', '1 stays in your inventory (…)'. Lower case: it continues a sentence. {{types}}: up to 3 chest type names in the player's language ('Reinforced chest'), joined with yavsos_list_and_*.
yavsos_reason_azu_excluded_types_more: As yavsos_reason_azu_excluded_types when there are more than 3 chest types. {{types}}: the first 3, joined with yavsos_list_comma_*.
yavsos_reason_both_remote: A reason in brackets after a count of stacks that stay: '2 stay in place (…)', '1 stays in your inventory (…)'. Lower case: it continues a sentence. Cleanup: the item would move between two chests that other players' games run. Also in brackets in the item tooltip's where-line ('Stash stack: stays in your inventory (…)', 160 characters in all).
yavsos_reason_budget: A reason in brackets after a count of stacks that stay: '2 stay in place (…)', '1 stays in your inventory (…)'. Lower case: it continues a sentence. The run reached its limit on moves; another run moves the rest. Also in brackets in the item tooltip's where-line ('Stash stack: stays in your inventory (…)', 160 characters in all).
yavsos_reason_categories_loading: A reason in brackets after a count of stacks that stay: '2 stay in place (…)', '1 stays in your inventory (…)'. Lower case: it continues a sentence. A chest with a category rule may accept it once categories finish loading. Also in brackets in the item tooltip's where-line ('Stash stack: stays in your inventory (…)', 160 characters in all).
yavsos_reason_chest_limit: A reason in brackets after a count of stacks that stay: '2 stay in place (…)', '1 stays in your inventory (…)'. Lower case: it continues a sentence. Cleanup reads only the nearest chests that hold items. {{count}}: that number (64). Also in brackets in the item tooltip's where-line ('Stash stack: stays in your inventory (…)', 160 characters in all).
yavsos_reason_held: A reason in brackets after a count of stacks that stay: '2 stay in place (…)', '1 stays in your inventory (…)'. Lower case: it continues a sentence. The stack is on the pointer, or an open inventory screen is moving it. Also in brackets in the item tooltip's where-line ('Stash stack: stays in your inventory (…)', 160 characters in all).
yavsos_reason_muc_busy: A reason in brackets after a count of stacks that stay: '2 stay in place (…)', '1 stays in your inventory (…)'. Lower case: it continues a sentence. Another player's chest already has a MultiUserChest request from this run. Also in brackets in the item tooltip's where-line ('Stash stack: stays in your inventory (…)', 160 characters in all).
yavsos_reason_muc_checking: A reason in brackets after a count of stacks that stay: '2 stay in place (…)', '1 stays in your inventory (…)'. Lower case: it continues a sentence. YAVSOS is still asking the other player's game whether MultiUserChest can take the request. Also in brackets in the item tooltip's where-line ('Stash stack: stays in your inventory (…)', 160 characters in all).
yavsos_reason_muc_format: A reason in brackets after a count of stacks that stay: '2 stay in place (…)', '1 stays in your inventory (…)'. Lower case: it continues a sentence. The other player's MultiUserChest uses an item format YAVSOS doesn't know, so YAVSOS doesn't send it the item. Also in brackets in the item tooltip's where-line ('Stash stack: stays in your inventory (…)', 160 characters in all).
yavsos_reason_muc_silent: A reason in brackets after a count of stacks that stay: '2 stay in place (…)', '1 stays in your inventory (…)'. Lower case: it continues a sentence. The other player's game didn't answer YAVSOS's MultiUserChest check; they may not have MultiUserChest. Also in brackets in the item tooltip's where-line ('Stash stack: stays in your inventory (…)', 160 characters in all).
yavsos_reason_muc_unusable: A reason in brackets after a count of stacks that stay: '2 stay in place (…)', '1 stays in your inventory (…)'. Lower case: it continues a sentence. The other player's MultiUserChest version can't handle item requests. Also in brackets in the item tooltip's where-line ('Stash stack: stays in your inventory (…)', 160 characters in all).
yavsos_reason_no_chest: A reason in brackets after a count of stacks that stay: '2 stay in place (…)', '1 stays in your inventory (…)'. Lower case: it continues a sentence. No chest in range has a rule that accepts the item. Also in brackets in the item tooltip's where-line ('Stash stack: stays in your inventory (…)', 160 characters in all).
yavsos_reason_no_muc: A reason in brackets after a count of stacks that stay: '2 stay in place (…)', '1 stays in your inventory (…)'. Lower case: it continues a sentence. The chest belongs to another player's game, and reaching it needs MultiUserChest, which this game doesn't have. Also in brackets in the item tooltip's where-line ('Stash stack: stays in your inventory (…)', 160 characters in all).
yavsos_reason_no_room: A reason in brackets after a count of stacks that stay: '2 stay in place (…)', '1 stays in your inventory (…)'. Lower case: it continues a sentence. The chests that accept it are full. Also used when the game refused a move for lack of room. Also in brackets in the item tooltip's where-line ('Stash stack: stays in your inventory (…)', 160 characters in all).
yavsos_reason_opted_out: A reason in brackets after a count of stacks that stay: '2 stay in place (…)', '1 stays in your inventory (…)'. Lower case: it continues a sentence. The chest's cleanup opt-out was ticked during the run. {{option}}: the tick box's text (yavsos_cleanup_optout); keep the quotes as your language writes them. Also in brackets in the item tooltip's where-line ('Stash stack: stays in your inventory (…)', 160 characters in all).
yavsos_reason_protected: A reason in brackets after a count of stacks that stay: '2 stay in place (…)', '1 stays in your inventory (…)'. Lower case: it continues a sentence. The stack is protected (by another mod, for example) or YAVSOS can't move it exactly. Also in brackets in the item tooltip's where-line ('Stash stack: stays in your inventory (…)', 160 characters in all).
yavsos_reason_unreadable: A reason in brackets after a count of stacks that stay: '2 stay in place (…)', '1 stays in your inventory (…)'. Lower case: it continues a sentence. YAVSOS couldn't read the stack's chest; the log has the details. Also in brackets in the item tooltip's where-line ('Stash stack: stays in your inventory (…)', 160 characters in all).
yavsos_redo_heading: Tooltip heading of the ↷ button beside Copy after an undo (the button redoes the change). Also {{button}} in yavsos_undo_heading_key.
yavsos_redo_tip: Tooltip of the ↷ (redo) button. {{rule}}: the chest label the redo puts back, in the label color, or 'No rule' (yavsos_panel_norule), faint, on its own line.
yavsos_redo_tip_in_use: Tooltip of the ↷ (redo) button while another player has the chest open.
yavsos_refusal_check_failed: A reason in brackets after a count of stacks that stay: '2 stay in place (…)', '1 stays in your inventory (…)'. Lower case: it continues a sentence. A refused move: one of YAVSOS's safety checks failed, so nothing moved. Rare.
yavsos_refusal_chest_changed: A reason in brackets after a count of stacks that stay: '2 stay in place (…)', '1 stays in your inventory (…)'. Lower case: it continues a sentence. A refused move: a chest's contents changed between planning and moving, so nothing moved.
yavsos_refusal_expired: A reason in brackets after a count of stacks that stay: '2 stay in place (…)', '1 stays in your inventory (…)'. Lower case: it continues a sentence. A refused move: the player walked too far away, or the move took too long.
yavsos_refusal_left_world: A reason in brackets after a count of stacks that stay: '2 stay in place (…)', '1 stays in your inventory (…)'. Lower case: it continues a sentence. A refused move: the player left the world during the run.
yavsos_refusal_muc_refused: A reason in brackets after a count of stacks that stay: '2 stay in place (…)', '1 stays in your inventory (…)'. Lower case: it continues a sentence. A refused move: MultiUserChest refused the request or gave the items back. Keep 'MultiUserChest' as written.
yavsos_refusal_no_access: A reason in brackets after a count of stacks that stay: '2 stay in place (…)', '1 stays in your inventory (…)'. Lower case: it continues a sentence. A refused move: the player has no access to the chest (a ward, for example).
yavsos_refusal_not_owner: A reason in brackets after a count of stacks that stay: '2 stay in place (…)', '1 stays in your inventory (…)'. Lower case: it continues a sentence. A refused move: another player's game runs the chest, so this game can't change it. Same words as the start of the yavsos_reason_muc_* reasons.
yavsos_refusal_owner_changed: A reason in brackets after a count of stacks that stay: '2 stay in place (…)', '1 stays in your inventory (…)'. Lower case: it continues a sentence. A refused move: another player's game took over a chest during the run.
yavsos_refusal_policy_changed: A reason in brackets after a count of stacks that stay: '2 stay in place (…)', '1 stays in your inventory (…)'. Lower case: it continues a sentence. A refused move: chest rules or the category settings changed during the run.
yavsos_refusal_rules_changed: A reason in brackets after a count of stacks that stay: '2 stay in place (…)', '1 stays in your inventory (…)'. Lower case: it continues a sentence. A refused move: a chest's rule changed during the run.
yavsos_refusal_turned_off: A reason in brackets after a count of stacks that stay: '2 stay in place (…)', '1 stays in your inventory (…)'. Lower case: it continues a sentence. A refused move: the server admin turned stashing or cleanup off during the run.
yavsos_refusal_unsupported: A reason in brackets after a count of stacks that stay: '2 stay in place (…)', '1 stays in your inventory (…)'. Lower case: it continues a sentence. A refused move: YAVSOS can't move this item safely, so it moved nothing.
yavsos_result_close: Button in the result panel's title row, 80 px wide at 17 px text (about 8 characters). Closes the panel early.
yavsos_result_empty_cleanup: Run summary when a cleanup found nothing to move and nothing to report: on-screen message, console and the strip under the YAVSOS panel's header (2 lines, about 105 characters).
yavsos_result_empty_stash: Run summary when a stash (YAVSOS's stash key, or AzuAutoStore's in the result panel) found nothing to stash and nothing to report.
yavsos_result_item: An item on a result panel line when there is more than one: 'Copper ×40'. {{name}}: the item's name in the player's language. {{times}}: items for what moved, stacks for the rest.
yavsos_result_items: Inside yavsos_result_moved and yavsos_result_stashed: how many items moved. {{count}}: the number of items.
yavsos_result_line: A result panel line that names items: 'Moved 2 stacks (13 items): Copper Ore ×8, Tin Ore ×5'. {{label}}: the line's outcome (a yavsos_result_ part). {{items}}: up to 4 item names, then '+N more'. The whole line is cut at 200 characters.
yavsos_result_moved: First part of a cleanup's summary and its first result panel line: what cleanup moved between chests. {{stacks}}: yavsos_result_stacks. {{items}}: yavsos_result_items. Part of the run summary (on-screen message, console, the strip under the YAVSOS panel's header, 2 lines, about 105 characters) and a result panel line (cut at 200 characters with the item names).
yavsos_result_moved_places: Result panel, X55: the first line after a cleanup when the lines below it name each chest that received items (yavsos_result_place_*). {{stacks}}: yavsos_result_stacks; {{items}}: yavsos_result_items; {{places}}: yavsos_result_places. Ends in a colon: the place lines follow. Cut at 200 characters. The run summary keeps yavsos_result_moved.
yavsos_result_moved_places_via: As yavsos_result_moved_places, when some stacks went through MultiUserChest (another player's chest). {{stacks}}: yavsos_result_stacks; {{items}}: yavsos_result_items; {{places}}: yavsos_result_places; {{via}}: yavsos_result_via_muc.
yavsos_result_moved_via: As yavsos_result_moved, when some of the stacks went through MultiUserChest (another player's chest). {{stacks}}: yavsos_result_stacks; {{items}}: yavsos_result_items; {{via}}: yavsos_result_via_muc.
yavsos_result_nothing_moved: Run summary when a cleanup moved nothing but has something to report. {{parts}}: the parts, such as '2 stay in place (no room)', joined by yavsos_list_parts_*. On-screen message, console and the strip under the YAVSOS panel's header (2 lines, about 105 characters; cut there, the whole text in its tooltip).
yavsos_result_nothing_stashed: Run summary when a stash moved nothing but has something to report. {{parts}}: the parts, such as '2 stay in your inventory (no room)', joined by yavsos_list_parts_*. On-screen message and console; the result panel shows it when lines didn't fit.
yavsos_result_place_labeled: Result panel, X55: under the first line, one line per chest or drawer that received items, each starting with the place's name, then ': ' and its items (yavsos_result_line); the whole line is cut at 200 characters. A chest with a rule: its name, then its chest label. {{chest}}: yavsos_where_chest_away ('Reinforced chest 5 m away') or yavsos_result_place_this / _nearby; {{label}}: the chest label from the rule, as the chest's hover text shows it (at most 56 characters). ' · ' is the separator the chest label itself uses.
yavsos_result_place_nearby: Result panel, X55: under the first line, one line per chest or drawer that received items, each starting with the place's name, then ': ' and its items (yavsos_result_line); the whole line is cut at 200 characters. A chest without a name, or one no longer there. Capitalized: it starts the line.
yavsos_result_place_this: Result panel, X55: under the first line, one line per chest or drawer that received items, each starting with the place's name, then ': ' and its items (yavsos_result_line); the whole line is cut at 200 characters. The chest that is open now. Capitalized: it starts the line.
yavsos_result_places: Inside yavsos_result_moved_places and yavsos_result_stashed_places: how many chests and item drawers received items. {{count}}: their number. 'Place' covers both chests and drawers.
yavsos_result_places_more: Result panel, X55: the last place line, in faint text, when not every chest or drawer that received items fits the panel's 8 lines. {{count}}: the places left out. Their items are still counted in the first line.
yavsos_result_range: Part of a cleanup's summary when more chests were in range than one run reads. {{count}}: the chests in range. {{nearest}}: yavsos_result_range_nearest, how many YAVSOS read.
yavsos_result_range_nearest: Inside yavsos_result_range: the chests YAVSOS read. {{count}}: their number.
yavsos_result_stacks: Inside yavsos_result_moved and yavsos_result_stashed: how many stacks moved. {{count}}: the number of stacks.
yavsos_result_stashed: First part of a stash's summary and its first result panel line, for YAVSOS's stash and AzuAutoStore's stash key. {{stacks}}: yavsos_result_stacks. {{items}}: yavsos_result_items. Part of the run summary (on-screen message, console, the strip under the YAVSOS panel's header, 2 lines, about 105 characters) and a result panel line (cut at 200 characters with the item names).
yavsos_result_stashed_places: Result panel, X55: the first line after a stash (YAVSOS's or AzuAutoStore's stash key) when the lines below it name each chest or item drawer that received items (yavsos_result_place_*). {{stacks}}: yavsos_result_stacks; {{items}}: yavsos_result_items; {{places}}: yavsos_result_places. Ends in a colon: the place lines follow. Cut at 200 characters. The run summary keeps yavsos_result_stashed.
yavsos_result_stashed_places_via: As yavsos_result_stashed_places, when some stacks went to another player's chest through MultiUserChest. {{stacks}}: yavsos_result_stacks; {{items}}: yavsos_result_items; {{places}}: yavsos_result_places; {{via}}: yavsos_result_via_muc.
yavsos_result_stashed_via: As yavsos_result_stashed, when some stacks went to another player's chest through MultiUserChest. {{stacks}}: yavsos_result_stacks; {{items}}: yavsos_result_items; {{via}}: yavsos_result_via_muc.
yavsos_result_stays_inventory: Stacks a stash didn't move, so they stay in the player's inventory. {{count}}: stacks. {{reason}}: why (a yavsos_reason_ or yavsos_refusal_ phrase). Part of the run summary (on-screen message, console, the strip under the YAVSOS panel's header, 2 lines, about 105 characters) and a result panel line (cut at 200 characters with the item names).
yavsos_result_stays_place: Stacks a cleanup didn't move, so they stay in their chest. {{count}}: stacks. {{reason}}: why (a yavsos_reason_ or yavsos_refusal_ phrase). Part of the run summary (on-screen message, console, the strip under the YAVSOS panel's header, 2 lines, about 105 characters) and a result panel line (cut at 200 characters with the item names).
yavsos_result_summary: Run summary when something moved. {{parts}}: the first part says what moved, then what stayed, joined by yavsos_list_parts_*. On-screen message, console and the strip under the YAVSOS panel's header; the result panel shows it when lines didn't fit.
yavsos_result_title_cleanup: Title of the result panel after a cleanup (panel 520 px wide, 19 px text; the Close button shares the row).
yavsos_result_title_stash: Title of the result panel after YAVSOS stashed the inventory or a stack (panel 520 px wide, 19 px text).
yavsos_result_title_stash_key: Title of the result panel after AzuAutoStore's stash key: YAVSOS shows what arrived in the chests (panel 520 px wide, 19 px text).
yavsos_result_unconfirmed: Stacks whose move YAVSOS couldn't confirm: they may or may not have moved, and YAVSOS doesn't try them again. {{count}}: stacks. Part of the run summary (on-screen message, console, the strip under the YAVSOS panel's header, 2 lines, about 105 characters) and a result panel line (cut at 200 characters with the item names).
yavsos_result_unconfirmed_via: As yavsos_result_unconfirmed, when some went through MultiUserChest. {{count}}: stacks YAVSOS couldn't confirm; {{via}}: yavsos_result_via_muc.
yavsos_result_unreadable: Nearby chests YAVSOS couldn't read, so the run left them out; the log has the details. {{count}}: chests. Part of the run summary (on-screen message, console, the strip under the YAVSOS panel's header, 2 lines, about 105 characters) and a result panel line (cut at 200 characters with the item names).
yavsos_result_via_muc: Inside a moved, stashed or unconfirmed part: how many of the stacks went through MultiUserChest. {{count}}: stacks. Keep 'MultiUserChest' as written (a mod's name).
yavsos_rule_clear: Button in the YAVSOS panel's Rule row, 120 px wide at 17 px text (about 12 characters); also the heading of its tooltip.
yavsos_rule_heading: Heading of the YAVSOS panel's Rule section, on one row with Copy, Paste and Clear rule: one short word.
yavsos_run_busy: On-screen message and the strip under the YAVSOS panel's header (2 lines, about 105 characters).
yavsos_run_categories_loading: On-screen message and the strip under the YAVSOS panel's header (2 lines, about 105 characters). Shown for a few seconds after joining a world.
yavsos_run_reader_checking: On-screen message and the strip under the YAVSOS panel's header (2 lines, about 105 characters). Shown only in the first moments after joining a world. Also a faint note in the item tooltip, under or in place of the where-line (yavsos_where_line).
yavsos_search_categories_hint: Placeholder text in the Categories tab's empty search box: one line at 17 px, at least 200 px wide (wider when the panel allows; about 28 characters fit). Text beyond the box is cut.
yavsos_search_categories_tip: Tooltip of the Categories tab's search box. Not a fixed spot.
yavsos_search_heading: Heading of the tooltip of both search boxes in the YAVSOS panel's Edit section.
yavsos_search_it: The thing searched for, in the search status line: 'it' for one item or a category, 'them' for several items. {{count}}: how many items the search asks for; not shown.
yavsos_search_items_hint: Placeholder text in the Items tab's empty search box: one line at 17 px, at least 200 px wide (wider when the panel allows; about 28 characters fit). Text beyond the box is cut.
yavsos_search_items_tip: Tooltip of the Items tab's search box. Not a fixed spot.
yavsos_search_none: The search status line under the Edit section's tab body: a 2-line spot at 15 px (about 50 characters a line), cut with '…' beyond that; keep the whole line under about 90 characters. Shown when a search in the Categories tab finds no category and no item.
yavsos_search_status: The search status line under the Edit section's tab body: a 2-line spot at 15 px (about 50 characters a line), cut with '…' beyond that; keep the whole line under about 90 characters. The whole line: {{parts}} is one or two phrases (how many chests hold the search's items, then how many more accept them), joined with yavsos_list_parts_*.
yavsos_search_status_accepts: The search status line under the Edit section's tab body: a 2-line spot at 15 px (about 50 characters a line), cut with '…' beyond that; keep the whole line under about 90 characters. Second phrase of yavsos_search_status (after ' · '), with the tag button on, when no chest holds a match. {{count}}: chests whose rules accept one; {{it}}: yavsos_search_it ('it' or 'them').
yavsos_search_status_accepts_more: The search status line under the Edit section's tab body: a 2-line spot at 15 px (about 50 characters a line), cut with '…' beyond that; keep the whole line under about 90 characters. Second phrase of yavsos_search_status (after ' · '), with the tag button on, after chests that hold a match. {{count}}: other chests whose rules accept one; {{it}}: yavsos_search_it ('it' or 'them').
yavsos_search_status_accepts_none: The search status line under the Edit section's tab body: a 2-line spot at 15 px (about 50 characters a line), cut with '…' beyond that; keep the whole line under about 90 characters. Second phrase of yavsos_search_status (after ' · ', so it starts lower-case in English), with the tag button on: some chests hold a match, no other chest accepts one. {{it}}: yavsos_search_it ('it' or 'them').
yavsos_search_status_holds: The search status line under the Edit section's tab body: a 2-line spot at 15 px (about 50 characters a line), cut with '…' beyond that; keep the whole line under about 90 characters. First phrase of yavsos_search_status. {{count}}: chests that hold a match; {{this}}: yavsos_search_this ('this' or 'these', by the number of items searched).
yavsos_search_status_holds_none: The search status line under the Edit section's tab body: a 2-line spot at 15 px (about 50 characters a line), cut with '…' beyond that; keep the whole line under about 90 characters. First phrase of yavsos_search_status when no chest holds a match but some accept one. {{this}}: yavsos_search_this ('this' or 'these', by the number of items searched).
yavsos_search_status_none: The search status line under the Edit section's tab body: a 2-line spot at 15 px (about 50 characters a line), cut with '…' beyond that; keep the whole line under about 90 characters. No chest in range holds what the search asks for. {{meters}}: the range searched, whole meters. {{count}}: how many items the search asks for (1 for a category or one item; this picks 'this' or 'these'); not shown.
yavsos_search_status_none_accepts: The search status line under the Edit section's tab body: a 2-line spot at 15 px (about 50 characters a line), cut with '…' beyond that; keep the whole line under about 90 characters. As yavsos_search_status_none, while the tag button also shows chests that accept the search's items. {{meters}}: the range, whole meters. {{count}}: how many items the search asks for; not shown.
yavsos_search_takers: The tag button beside each search box: its name, as the heading of its tooltip. Settings descriptions quote it (yavsos_setting_controls_takescolor, yavsos_setting_controls_searchshowstakers).
yavsos_search_takers_off: Body of the tag button's tooltip while it is off.
yavsos_search_takers_on: Body of the tag button's tooltip while it is on. 'The accepts color' and 'the holds color': the colors set in the settings TakesColor and HoldsColor.
yavsos_search_this: The thing searched for, in the search status line: 'this' for one item or a category, 'these' for several items. {{count}}: how many items the search asks for; not shown.
yavsos_search_tip_accepts: A line of the search status line's tooltip, one per chest, nearest first. {{chest}}: yavsos_search_tip_chest or yavsos_search_tip_this_chest. The chest's rule accepts a match.
yavsos_search_tip_chest: In the search status line's tooltip: another chest. {{chest}}: the chest's name from the game, in the player's language; {{meters}}: its distance from the player, whole meters.
yavsos_search_tip_heading: Heading of the search status line's tooltip. {{subject}}: what the search lights chests for: a category's name, or item names joined with yavsos_list_comma_* and '+N more'.
yavsos_search_tip_heading_it: Heading of the search status line's tooltip when the search names nothing.
yavsos_search_tip_holds: A line of the search status line's tooltip, one per chest, nearest first. {{chest}}: yavsos_search_tip_chest or yavsos_search_tip_this_chest. The chest holds a match.
yavsos_search_tip_this_chest: In the search status line's tooltip: the chest open beside the YAVSOS panel.
yavsos_setting_cleanup_range: Configuration Manager (F1) tooltip of the setting Cleanup.Range, and its comment in the .cfg file (in English there). No length limit. {{setting}}: the setting name MaximumRange, not translated.
yavsos_setting_cleanup_shortcut: Configuration Manager (F1) tooltip of the setting Cleanup.Shortcut, and its comment in the .cfg file (in English there). No length limit. {{button}}: the Clean up nearby button's text (yavsos_cleanup_button). 'None' and 'Ctrl' are what the Configuration Manager shows for the key; keep them as written.
yavsos_setting_controls_chestarrivaleffe: Configuration Manager (F1) tooltip of the setting Controls.ChestArrivalEffect, and its comment in the .cfg file (in English there). No length limit. 'None' is the setting's value as the Configuration Manager lists it; keep it as written.
yavsos_setting_controls_highlightseconds: Configuration Manager (F1) tooltip of the setting Controls.HighlightSecondsAfterClose, and its comment in the .cfg file (in English there). No length limit. {{setting}}: the setting name ChestArrivalEffect, not translated.
yavsos_setting_controls_holdscolor: Configuration Manager (F1) tooltip of the setting Controls.HoldsColor, and its comment in the .cfg file (in English there). No length limit. 'Alpha': the color's transparency value, as the Configuration Manager's color editor names it.
yavsos_setting_controls_panelfolded: Configuration Manager (F1) tooltip of the setting Controls.PanelFolded, and its comment in the .cfg file (in English there). No length limit.
yavsos_setting_controls_paneloffsetx: Configuration Manager (F1) tooltip of the setting Controls.PanelOffsetX, and its comment in the .cfg file (in English there). No length limit.
yavsos_setting_controls_paneloffsety: Configuration Manager (F1) tooltip of the setting Controls.PanelOffsetY, and its comment in the .cfg file (in English there). No length limit.
yavsos_setting_controls_resultpanelholdi: Configuration Manager (F1) tooltip of the setting Controls.ResultPanelHoldInInventory, and its comment in the .cfg file (in English there). No length limit. {{setting}}: the setting name ResultPanelSeconds, not translated; it counts seconds.
yavsos_setting_controls_resultpanelsecon: Configuration Manager (F1) tooltip of the setting Controls.ResultPanelSeconds, and its comment in the .cfg file (in English there). No length limit. {{button}}: the result panel's Close button (yavsos_result_close).
yavsos_setting_controls_searchshowstaker: Configuration Manager (F1) tooltip of the setting Controls.SearchShowsTakers, and its comment in the .cfg file (in English there). No length limit. {{button}}: the tag button's name, the heading of its tooltip (yavsos_search_takers).
yavsos_setting_controls_showchestlabels: Configuration Manager (F1) tooltip of the setting Controls.ShowChestLabels, and its comment in the .cfg file (in English there). No length limit. The quoted example is a chest label as the game shows it; use that label's words in your language.
yavsos_setting_controls_showitemcategori: Configuration Manager (F1) tooltip of the setting Controls.ShowItemCategories, and its comment in the .cfg file (in English there). No length limit. The quoted example is an item tooltip's category line; use that line's words in your language.
yavsos_setting_controls_showresultpanel: Configuration Manager (F1) tooltip of the setting Controls.ShowResultPanel, and its comment in the .cfg file (in English there). No length limit.
yavsos_setting_controls_showrulecontrols: Configuration Manager (F1) tooltip of the setting Controls.ShowRuleControls, and its comment in the .cfg file (in English there). No length limit.
yavsos_setting_controls_stayscolor: Configuration Manager (F1) tooltip of the setting Controls.StaysColor, and its comment in the .cfg file (in English there). No length limit. 'Alpha': the color's transparency value, as the Configuration Manager's color editor names it.
yavsos_setting_controls_takescolor: Configuration Manager (F1) tooltip of the setting Controls.TakesColor, and its comment in the .cfg file (in English there). No length limit. {{button}}: the tag button's name, the heading of its tooltip (yavsos_search_takers). 'Alpha': the color's transparency value.
yavsos_setting_server_allowcleanup: Configuration Manager (F1) tooltip of the setting Server.AllowCleanup, and its comment in the .cfg file (in English there). No length limit.
yavsos_setting_server_allowstashing: Configuration Manager (F1) tooltip of the setting Server.AllowStashing, and its comment in the .cfg file (in English there). No length limit.
yavsos_setting_server_locksharedpolicy: Configuration Manager (F1) tooltip of the setting Server.LockSharedPolicy, and its comment in the .cfg file (in English there). No length limit. ServerSync: the library that sends the server's settings to players; keep its name.
yavsos_setting_server_maximumchests: Configuration Manager (F1) tooltip of the setting Server.MaximumChests, and its comment in the .cfg file (in English there). No length limit.
yavsos_setting_server_maximumrange: Configuration Manager (F1) tooltip of the setting Server.MaximumRange, and its comment in the .cfg file (in English there). No length limit.
yavsos_setting_stash_azuautostore: Configuration Manager (F1) tooltip of every Stash setting while AzuAutoStore is installed, and their comment in the .cfg file (in English there). {{description}}: the setting's own description (a yavsos_setting_stash_ text). No length limit.
yavsos_setting_stash_includehotbar: Configuration Manager (F1) tooltip of the setting Stash.IncludeHotbar, and its comment in the .cfg file (in English there). No length limit. {{setting}}: AzuAutoStore's setting name 'Player Ignore Hotbar', in English as AzuAutoStore shows it; keep the quotes.
yavsos_setting_stash_includequickslots: Configuration Manager (F1) tooltip of the setting Stash.IncludeQuickSlots, and its comment in the .cfg file (in English there). No length limit. AzuExtendedPlayerInventory: a mod's name; keep it.
yavsos_setting_stash_range: Configuration Manager (F1) tooltip of the setting Stash.Range, and its comment in the .cfg file (in English there). No length limit. {{setting}}: the setting name MaximumRange, not translated.
yavsos_setting_stash_shortcut: Configuration Manager (F1) tooltip of the setting Stash.Shortcut, and its comment in the .cfg file (in English there). No length limit.
yavsos_setting_stash_singleitemshortcut: Configuration Manager (F1) tooltip of the setting Stash.SingleItemShortcut, and its comment in the .cfg file (in English there). No length limit.
yavsos_stash_azu: On-screen message when YAVSOS's own stash is asked to run while AzuAutoStore is installed.
yavsos_stash_categories_partial: On-screen message, top left. 'Always': the item mark for items a chest always accepts; use the same word as the panel.
yavsos_stash_inventory_open: On-screen message, center, when the player presses the stash key with the inventory open and no stack key is set.
yavsos_stash_inventory_open_key: On-screen message, center, when the player presses the stash key with the inventory open. {{key}}: the stack key, for example 'Middle mouse'.
yavsos_stash_no_player: On-screen message, top left. Rare: the player is dead or not in a world.
yavsos_stash_off_server: On-screen message, top left. The server admin turned stashing off.
yavsos_stash_reader_broken: On-screen message, top left, and the Stashing status mark's tooltip line. The game changed, so YAVSOS turned its stash and cleanup off; the log has the details. Also a faint note in the item tooltip, under or in place of the where-line (yavsos_where_line).
yavsos_stash_single_refused: On-screen message, top left, when the stack key is pressed on a stack YAVSOS can't move (equipped, a quest item, or one YAVSOS can't move exactly). Also a faint note in the item tooltip, under or in place of the where-line (yavsos_where_line).
yavsos_suggest_always: Clickable suggestion chip under the rule's chips (X22), after a drawn check mark: 'these items' are the chest's items the rule doesn't accept yet, which the tooltip lists. On the second suggestion row, 402 px to itself when the Set rule chip is offered; otherwise on the first row beside a ✕ chip (about 374 px). Cut with '…' if it doesn't fit (the tooltip has it whole). Also the heading of its tooltip.
yavsos_suggest_always_tip: Tooltip of the 'Always: these items' chip on a chest without a rule. 'Always': the item mark, as on the panel. {{items}}: the items' names, comma-separated, in the label color, '+N more' after 12.
yavsos_suggest_always_tip_rule: Tooltip of the 'Always: these items' chip on a chest whose rule doesn't accept some of what it holds. 'Always': the item mark, as on the panel. {{items}}: those items' names, comma-separated, in the label color, '+N more' after 12.
yavsos_suggest_dismiss: Tooltip heading of the ✕ chip at the end of the suggestion row (X22).
yavsos_suggest_dismiss_tip: Tooltip of the ✕ chip at the end of the suggestion row (X22).
yavsos_suggest_set: Clickable suggestion chip on its own row under the rule's chips (X22), after a drawn star. {{category}}: a category's name as the panel shows it. Shares one 402 px row with the Always chip and a ✕ chip; cut with '…' when it doesn't fit. Also the heading of its tooltip. Worded to avoid an article before the category name.
yavsos_suggest_set_tip: Tooltip of the 'Set rule' chip. {{count}}: the stacks in the chest (picks the plural form; 1 uses _one); {{stacks}}: how many of them are in the category; {{category}}: the category's name.
yavsos_tab_categories: Tab in the YAVSOS panel's Edit section, a 100 px button at 17 px text (about 10 characters); also the heading of its tooltip.
yavsos_tab_categories_tip: Tooltip of the Categories tab. Not a fixed spot.
yavsos_tab_filters: Tab in the YAVSOS panel's Edit section, a 100 px button at 17 px text (about 10 characters); also the heading of its tooltip.
yavsos_tab_filters_tip: Tooltip of the Filters tab. Not a fixed spot. 'Rarity', 'upgrade level', 'damaged', 'crafter': filter names as the Filters tab shows them; use the same words.
yavsos_tab_heading: Heading of the YAVSOS panel, Edit section (the tabs, search and item grid below it), 17 px, one line. Other messages may quote it as the Edit section.
yavsos_tab_items: Tab in the YAVSOS panel's Edit section (the item grid), a 100 px button at 17 px text (about 10 characters); also the heading of its tooltip. Other messages quote it, so they use this key.
yavsos_tab_items_tip: Tooltip of the Items tab. Not a fixed spot. {{always}}, {{never}}: the item marks' names (yavsos_grid_always, yavsos_grid_never). 'Amber': the icon's color when AzuAutoStore's settings keep the item out of this chest type.
yavsos_tree_hidden: A row above the Edit section's tabs, 15 px, wraps. {{count}}: parts of the rule this YAVSOS version can't show; {{button}}: the Clear rule button's text (yavsos_rule_clear).
yavsos_tree_ignored_category: A row above the Edit section's tabs, one per category the rule names that this game doesn't have; 15 px, beside an 80 px Remove button (about 40 characters a line; longer rows wrap). {{id}}: the category's stored ID, shown as it is.
yavsos_tree_ignored_filter: A row above the Edit section's tabs, one per filter this YAVSOS version doesn't know; 15 px, beside an 80 px Remove button (longer rows wrap). {{filter}}: the filter's stored ID, shown as it is.
yavsos_tree_ignored_value: A row above the Edit section's tabs, one per filter value this YAVSOS version doesn't know; 15 px, beside an 80 px Remove button (longer rows wrap). {{filter}}, {{value}}: the stored IDs, shown as they are.
yavsos_tree_note: A Categories tree row while searching, one line (the row's width less its indent, about 40 characters at the top level): the category's name, then a faint note. {{category}}: the category's name; {{note}}: yavsos_tree_note_names, _cut or _hidden. The panel drops names until the row fits.
yavsos_tree_note_cut: As yavsos_tree_note_names when more items were found than fit: '…' stands for the rest. {{names}}: one or two names.
yavsos_tree_note_hidden: As yavsos_tree_note_names when no name fits: '…' stands for the items found.
yavsos_tree_note_names: Faint note after a category's name in the Categories tree while searching (see yavsos_tree_note). {{names}}: the items found in this category, one or two, joined with yavsos_list_comma_*.
yavsos_tree_remove: Button on each ignored row above the Edit section's tabs, 80 px at 17 px text (about 8 characters).
yavsos_tree_tip: Tooltip of a Categories tree row (its heading is the category's name). Not a fixed spot.
yavsos_tree_tip_has: Tooltip of a Categories tree row while searching. {{names}}: every item the search found in this category, joined with yavsos_list_and_*; {{tip}}: yavsos_tree_tip.
yavsos_tree_tip_shown: Tooltip of a Categories tree row shown only because a category under it matches the search. {{tip}}: yavsos_tree_tip.
yavsos_undo_heading: Tooltip heading of the ↶ button beside Copy (X26); also {{button}} in yavsos_undo_heading_key.
yavsos_undo_heading_key: Tooltip heading of the ↶ (undo) and ↷ (redo) buttons. {{button}}: Undo or Redo (yavsos_undo_heading, yavsos_redo_heading); {{key}}: the key, 'Ctrl + Z'.
yavsos_undo_tip: Tooltip of the ↶ (undo) button. {{rule}}: the chest label the undo puts back, in the label color, or 'No rule' (yavsos_panel_norule), faint, on its own line.
yavsos_undo_tip_in_use: Tooltip of the ↶ (undo) button while another player has the chest open.
yavsos_undo_tip_none: Tooltip of the ↶ (undo) button, dimmed, when the player hasn't changed this chest's rule in this world yet.
yavsos_where_azu_decides: Item tooltip, inventory screen: the last line of a stack's tooltip says where the stash key or Clean up nearby would put it. The whole line is at most 160 characters, cut with '…'. After the lead ('Stash stack:', 'Clean up:'), lower case: it continues the line. With AzuAutoStore installed, when no chest with a rule accepts the stack, AzuAutoStore's own settings decide where it goes. {{reason}}: a lower-case reason (yavsos_where_reason_*, yavsos_reason_*).
yavsos_where_because_always: Item tooltip, inventory screen: the last line of a stack's tooltip says where the stash key or Clean up nearby would put it. The whole line is at most 160 characters, cut with '…'. Why the chosen chest accepts the stack, in brackets after the chest; lower case. The chest's rule lists the item under Always. 'Always': the item mark, as on the panel.
yavsos_where_because_category: Item tooltip, inventory screen: the last line of a stack's tooltip says where the stash key or Clean up nearby would put it. The whole line is at most 160 characters, cut with '…'. Why the chosen chest accepts the stack, in brackets after the chest; lower case. {{category}}: the category of the chest's rule that the item belongs to (a category name).
yavsos_where_because_filters: Item tooltip, inventory screen: the last line of a stack's tooltip says where the stash key or Clean up nearby would put it. The whole line is at most 160 characters, cut with '…'. Why the chosen chest accepts the stack, in brackets after the chest; lower case. The chest's rule has filters and no category, and the stack matches them.
yavsos_where_because_holds: Item tooltip, inventory screen: the last line of a stack's tooltip says where the stash key or Clean up nearby would put it. The whole line is at most 160 characters, cut with '…'. Why the chosen chest accepts the stack, in brackets after the chest; lower case. The chest already holds that item.
yavsos_where_chest_away: Item tooltip, inventory screen: the last line of a stack's tooltip says where the stash key or Clean up nearby would put it. The whole line is at most 160 characters, cut with '…'. After the lead ('Stash stack:', 'Clean up:'), lower case: it continues the line. The chest a stack goes to. {{chest}}: the chest's name from the game; {{meters}}: how far it is, in whole meters. Also starts a result panel place line (X55), 'Reinforced chest 5 m away: Copper ×60', where the line is cut at 200 characters.
yavsos_where_chest_nearby: Item tooltip, inventory screen: the last line of a stack's tooltip says where the stash key or Clean up nearby would put it. The whole line is at most 160 characters, cut with '…'. After the lead ('Stash stack:', 'Clean up:'), lower case: it continues the line. A chest without a name, as the chest a stack goes to.
yavsos_where_chest_this: Item tooltip, inventory screen: the last line of a stack's tooltip says where the stash key or Clean up nearby would put it. The whole line is at most 160 characters, cut with '…'. After the lead ('Stash stack:', 'Clean up:'), lower case: it continues the line. The chest that is open now, as the chest a stack goes to.
yavsos_where_cleanup_moves: Item tooltip, inventory screen: the last line of a stack's tooltip says where the stash key or Clean up nearby would put it. The whole line is at most 160 characters, cut with '…'. After the lead ('Stash stack:', 'Clean up:'), lower case: it continues the line. Clean up nearby would move the stack. {{chest}}: yavsos_where_chest_*.
yavsos_where_cleanup_moves_because: Item tooltip, inventory screen: the last line of a stack's tooltip says where the stash key or Clean up nearby would put it. The whole line is at most 160 characters, cut with '…'. After the lead ('Stash stack:', 'Clean up:'), lower case: it continues the line. As yavsos_where_cleanup_moves, with why that chest accepts it. {{chest}}: yavsos_where_chest_*; {{because}}: yavsos_where_because_*.
yavsos_where_cleanup_stays: Item tooltip, inventory screen: the last line of a stack's tooltip says where the stash key or Clean up nearby would put it. The whole line is at most 160 characters, cut with '…'. After the lead ('Stash stack:', 'Clean up:'), lower case: it continues the line. Clean up nearby would leave the stack in the open chest.
yavsos_where_cleanup_stays_reason: Item tooltip, inventory screen: the last line of a stack's tooltip says where the stash key or Clean up nearby would put it. The whole line is at most 160 characters, cut with '…'. After the lead ('Stash stack:', 'Clean up:'), lower case: it continues the line. As yavsos_where_cleanup_stays, with why. {{reason}}: a lower-case reason (yavsos_where_reason_*, yavsos_reason_*).
yavsos_where_lead_cleanup: Item tooltip, inventory screen: the last line of a stack's tooltip says where the stash key or Clean up nearby would put it. The whole line is at most 160 characters, cut with '…'. The line's lead, in orange, for a stack in the open chest: what Clean up nearby would do with it.
yavsos_where_lead_stash: Item tooltip, inventory screen: the last line of a stack's tooltip says where the stash key or Clean up nearby would put it. The whole line is at most 160 characters, cut with '…'. The line's lead, in orange, for a stack in the player's inventory: what the stack key would do with it.
yavsos_where_lead_stash_key: Item tooltip, inventory screen: the last line of a stack's tooltip says where the stash key or Clean up nearby would put it. The whole line is at most 160 characters, cut with '…'. As yavsos_where_lead_stash, with the stack key. {{key}}: the key's name, such as 'Middle mouse' (yavsos_key_*).
yavsos_where_line: Item tooltip, inventory screen: the last line of a stack's tooltip says where the stash key or Clean up nearby would put it.
